name: Signup phone verification (SMS OTP) — approval frames
description: FFRNT-361: SMS phone verification as a step of account registration. Freezes where the step sits in signup (immediately after POST /signup issues a session, before the approved check-inbox screen, in parallel with email verification), the single exit rule that skips check-inbox when no email is pending, the flagged sign-in re-prompt for policy=required, the enter-phone → sending → enter-code → verified path, and every state the UI must render: wrong / expired / too-many-attempts (429) codes, send failure, send rate-limit, SMS channel unavailable (honest degrade, never a dead end), number can't be used (409 only after a correct code — no enumeration), server-rejected number, both skip-policy outcomes, loading, already-verified, resume-after-reload, session expired and generic error — at desktop and 375px. Approving the flow approves the build inventory below and the listed contract deltas. frontend-test-engineer drives Playwright against the data-frame / data-* hooks.

notes: mfa-stepup-mobile/03-confirm-contact.html (flow confirm-contact-phone, approved: false) is the post-signup/settings phone OTP screen. This feature is the SIGNUP context of the same screen: same data-panel='confirm-contact', same state names (enter-phone, sending, enter-code, error-invalid, error-send, verified) and action names (send-code, verify-contact, resend, skip), plus data-context='signup' and the states that frame is missing (error-expired, error-locked/429, error-rate-limited, error-unavailable, error-number-unavailable, loading, already-verified, resumed, error-session, error-generic). OtpInput is the same primitive, with cells widened to 44x52 so BOTH dimensions meet the 44px tap target; mfa-stepup-mobile's 42px-wide cells should adopt 44px on its next iteration. Implementation must be ONE ContactVerifyPanel + state machine used in both contexts, not a parallel component tree. If this feature is approved first, confirm-contact-phone should adopt these states on its next iteration.

auth-experience (signup, verify-email approved) is NOT edited. 01-signup, 03-check-inbox and 04-verify-landing are unchanged; email stays link-click (the same ruling mfa-stepup-mobile recorded). The only changes to approved flows are flagged routing deltas: signup's post-201 navigation targets /signup/phone when this step applies, and signin's post-success navigation re-prompts under policy=required (see contract.deltas).
After a skip, the reminder surface is the existing 'Unverified' phone chip in account-security / mfa-stepup-mobile 04-security-status; no new reminder surface is introduced.
openQuestionsForOwner: Skip policy default — these frames recommend and assume 'optional'; 'required' is fully designed in 07-skip-policy.html.
May one phone number be shared by more than one account? If yes, the 409 PHONE_UNAVAILABLE state is removed.
Package home of the shared ContactVerifyPanel — assumed @fuzefront/auth-ui, consumed by @fuzefront/account-security-ui for the settings context.

gate-frames-first coverage overlap: auth-experience's APPROVED flows claim packages/auth-ui/src/**, which contains this feature's implementation path, so check-frames-first.mjs ('ONE approved flow claiming this file is enough') would pass this feature's UI before these frames are approved. Fix = narrow auth-experience's implementation.paths (changes its stamp, needs re-approval) or have the gate prefer the most specific claim.

decisions.placement: After POST /v1/security/signup → 201 (session issued) and BEFORE auth-experience 03-check-inbox, in parallel with email verification. Phone verify REQUIRES an authenticated session (requireBearer on /verify/phone/start and /verify/status in backend/security/src/routes/security.ts); signup already establishes one, so the step runs immediately with no extra sign-in. Not after email verification: that is a non-blocking link-click that may complete on another device without a session, and it would make a working SMS step depend on email delivery.
decisions.skipPolicy: Server-driven AuthMethods.verification.phoneAtSignup: off | optional | required (contract delta). Recommended default: optional (Skip visible, reminder in Settings → Security). required removes the user's own Skip on enter-phone/enter-code but never blocks account creation and never dead-ends: EVERY failure state (502 send failure, 429 rate-limit/lockout, 503 SMS unavailable, 409, network error / unclassified 5xx) carries continue-without-phone in place of Skip, and the sign-in redirect (decisions.signinReprompt) re-prompts later.
decisions.noEnumeration: POST /verify/phone/start answers 202 for any well-formed number regardless of other accounts. 409 PHONE_UNAVAILABLE is returned only by /confirm after a CORRECT code, so only someone in possession of the phone can learn the number is unusable, and the copy still does not assert that another account exists.
decisions.honestDegrade: AuthMethods.verification.sms === false (no SMS_SERVICE_URL) → the step is never rendered (routed past). 503 mid-flow → 'Text messages aren't available right now' + Continue. No vendor name anywhere in the UI.
decisions.e164: Client: country calling-code + national number normalised with libphonenumber-js (MIT; adopt, don't hand-roll) and shown as the exact E.164 string sent; Send disabled until valid. Server re-validates (400 PHONE_INVALID).
decisions.exitRule: nextAfterPhone() resolves EVERY exit from the step — Continue after verified, Skip, continue-without-phone deferral, and every bypass (flag/policy off, sms unavailable, already verified) — from a freshly re-fetched GET /verify/status: verification.email === true AND emailVerified === false → /signup/verify (check inbox); otherwise (email off, or confirmed in parallel) → the app (?next= or default app). The check-inbox screen is never shown when no email was sent or the email is already confirmed. Exit controls carry data-next='verify-email'|'app'. The exit NEVER blocks on the refresh: GET /verify/status is retried with a short timeout (~3s); on failure or timeout the exit uses the snapshot of GET /methods + GET /verify/status loaded at step entry (always present — no interactive control renders before it) and navigates immediately. Worst case of a stale snapshot is showing check-inbox for an email just confirmed (harmless); it can never trap the user, which is what makes Skip / continue-without-phone work during an outage.
decisions.signinReprompt: Flagged redirect after any successful sign-in (SignInFlow, incl. after MFA step-up), before navigating to ?next=: if flag ON AND phoneAtSignup === 'required' AND phoneVerified === false AND verification.sms === true → /signup/phone?next=<original> (same flow, progress rail hidden, exits return to ?next=). Otherwise ?next= as today. Evaluated once per sign-in; a deferral holds until the next sign-in. Under 'optional' there is no redirect — only the 'Unverified' chip in Security. Never re-wrap: if the post-sign-in next already targets /signup/phone, navigate to it as-is (no /signup/phone?next=/signup/phone…), keeping its nested downstream target. Session expiry inside the step sends the user to sign-in with the WHOLE current location encoded as next (e.g. /login?next=%2Fsignup%2Fphone%3Fnext%3D%252Fapps%252Fplan), so the original target survives and there is no loop.
decisions.otpEntry: CODE_INVALID clears the rejected digits and focuses cell 1; Confirm is disabled until 6 new digits are entered, so a resubmit cannot burn an attempt. Resend: the provider may re-send the SAME still-valid code without extending its lifetime, so the expiry countdown always takes the server's remaining time from the new ack (expiresInSeconds) and only the resend cooldown restarts; typed digits are kept and whichever code the server accepts works. A confirm-time OUTAGE (503 VERIFY_UNAVAILABLE) is different from a wrong code: digits are KEPT, no attempt is consumed, Try again re-submits the same code. Resend uses the session-bound POST /verify/phone/resend (empty body), so it works after a reload with only the masked number.
decisions.a11y: Panels are not live regions. Countdowns update visually but are never announced per second; a dedicated visually-hidden [data-announcer] (role=status, aria-live=polite) speaks milestones only (code sent, you can request a new code now, verified); errors are role=alert. OtpInput cells are 44x52 (>= 44px both ways).
decisions.copy: Copy promises only what /verify/phone does — confirm a contact number on the account. It does not claim the number enables text-message sign-in codes or account recovery; SMS MFA enrolment is a separate flow (mfa-management).
decisions.progressRail: SignupProgress is built from data: the Email step renders only when AuthMethods.verification.email === true AND VerificationStatus.emailVerified === false (data-email-step='shown'|'omitted'). It is an ordered list; the current step has aria-current='step', and every step carries visually hidden state text (completed / current step / not started / skipped) so state is never conveyed only by data attributes or colour.
decisions.fieldIds: Every PhoneNumberField instance has unique ids (pv-cc-N, pv-phone-N, pv-phone-err-N); label for= and aria-describedby reference that instance only.

contract.featureFlagDefault: OFF — target the builders audience (owner + QA synthetic accounts) so prod-smoke and e2e can see it; gate both the route and the signup redirect.
contract.smsAvailabilityAdvertised: Yes — AuthMethods.verification.sms (required), derived from SMS_SERVICE_URL in GET /v1/security/methods.
contract.authRequirement: start + status require a bearer session (requireBearer); confirm currently does NOT (see delta 1). Signup's 201 LoginResponse supplies the session, so the step runs right after signup.
deltas: SECURITY — POST /v1/security/verify/phone/confirm must declare and enforce bearerAuth and bind to the session user. Today the route has no requireBearer, the OpenAPI operation has no `security`, and AuthentikIdentityProvider.confirmPhoneVerification runs users.where({ phone }).update({ phone_verified: true }) — marking EVERY account holding that number verified.

POST /verify/phone/start must not write users.phone before possession is proven (today it updates users.phone then sends). Hold a pending number; promote it on confirm. PhoneVerifyConfirmRequest becomes { code } (phone optional; if supplied it must equal the pending number).

NEW 202 body PhoneVerifyStartAck { maskedPhone: string, expiresInSeconds: integer, resendAfterSeconds: integer } — drives the resend cooldown and expiry countdown instead of client-hard-coded timers. On a resend, expiresInSeconds is the AUTHORITATIVE remaining lifetime of the active code (the provider may re-send the same unexpired code without extending it), not a fresh full window.

POST /verify/phone/start error taxonomy: 400 PHONE_INVALID (server-side E.164 + SMS-capable), 429 RATE_LIMITED + Retry-After (per user, per number, per IP — no limiter exists on this route today), 502 SMS_SEND_FAILED, 503 SMS_UNAVAILABLE + Retry-After. Today any transport error falls through sendError to 401 UNKNOWN 'Authentication failed', which a client must read as a lost session.

POST /verify/phone/confirm error taxonomy: 422 CODE_INVALID { attemptsRemaining }, 422 CODE_EXPIRED, 429 TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS + Retry-After, 409 PHONE_UNAVAILABLE (only after a correct code), and a distinct OUTAGE outcome 503 VERIFY_UNAVAILABLE + Retry-After (or 502 VERIFY_FAILED) when sms-service /sms/verify times out or returns non-2xx — it must NOT consume an attempt and must NOT read as a wrong code. Today wrong and expired both return 401 NOT_ACTIVE — indistinguishable from session expiry — and HttpNotificationClient.checkSmsOtp maps every non-2xx (incl. sms-service 429) to false. Distinguishing expired/max-attempts needs sms-service /sms/verify to return a status (pending|approved|expired|max_attempts) — a family sms-service change, delegate accordingly.
No-enumeration: POST /verify/phone/start returns 202 for every well-formed number whether or not it is held by another account; uniqueness is decided only at confirm.

NEW VerificationStatus.phonePending?: { maskedPhone, expiresInSeconds, resendAfterSeconds } — lets a reload resume at enter-code without a second SMS. The client only ever gets the MASKED number back; it never needs the full number again (confirm is { code }, resend is the empty-body /resend below).

NEW POST /v1/security/verify/phone/resend — bearerAuth, EMPTY body, resends to the pending number held server-side for the session user and returns PhoneVerifyStartAck. Errors: 404 NO_PENDING_VERIFICATION (no active challenge → client returns to enter-phone), 429 RATE_LIMITED + Retry-After, 502 SMS_SEND_FAILED, 503 SMS_UNAVAILABLE. All enter-code Resend controls ([data-resend-via='session']) use it, so Resend works after a reload where only phonePending.maskedPhone is known. POST /verify/phone/start stays the only call that accepts a full phone (first send / change number).

Routing (frontend, flagged): auth-experience signup's post-201 navigation targets /signup/phone when the step applies, else nextAfterPhone() — /signup/verify only if verification.email is true and emailVerified is false, otherwise the app. No approved frame changes.

Routing (frontend, flagged): auth-experience signin's post-success navigation re-prompts → /signup/phone?next=<original> when phoneAtSignup === 'required' AND phoneVerified === false AND verification.sms === true (decisions.signinReprompt). No approved frame changes.

sms-service + notification client — confirm outage: HttpNotificationClient.checkSmsOtp maps transport errors and every non-2xx to false (→ 401 'invalid or expired code'), and sms-service /sms/verify (services/sms-service/src/routes/verify.ts) returns only { verified: boolean } with provider errors unhandled (→ 500). Required: /sms/verify returns { status: 'approved'|'pending'|'expired'|'max_attempts' } and a 503 on provider failure; checkSmsOtp returns a tagged result (approved | invalid | expired | locked | unavailable) instead of a boolean, so /confirm can map unavailable → 503 VERIFY_UNAVAILABLE.

sms-service + notification client — rate-limit pass-through: sms-service /sms/send (services/sms-service/src/routes/send.ts) answers 429 with only { error } and no Retry-After, and HttpNotificationClient.sendSmsOtp throws away the response (throws 'returned HTTP 429'). Required: sms-service sets Retry-After and { retryAfterSeconds } from its RateLimiter window; sendSmsOtp parses it into a typed RateLimitedError { retryAfterSeconds }; /start and /resend map that to 429 RATE_LIMITED + Retry-After. Without it the 429 countdowns in 05/06 have no authoritative value.

externalPackages: libphonenumber-js (MIT) — E.164 parsing/formatting + per-country length validation
designSystemAdditions: OtpInput — 6-cell, paste-aware, arrow/backspace nav, autocomplete=one-time-code on cell 1, 44x52 cells (>= 44px in both dimensions). Already named missing by mfa-management and mfa-stepup-mobile: build ONCE.
PhoneInput / CountryCodeSelect — flag + dial-code select paired with a tel input, >=44px target.
Alert info/warning variants — add if still missing.

frames.label: Index
frames.summary: Flow walker (8 frames in order), frozen decisions, build inventory, contract binding + deltas, reconciliation with mfa-stepup-mobile / auth-experience, open questions.
frames.acceptanceNotes: index links to every frame in order; the build inventory mirrors manifest.build 1:1; reconciliation, deltas and the gate-coverage open question are visible in the page, not only in manifest.json.

frames.label: (01) Where the step sits
frames.summary: Signup → phone → check inbox / app, with the placement rationale, the single exit rule nextAfterPhone(), the post-signup routing table (flag/policy off, SMS unavailable, already verified, pending resume, default) and the flagged sign-in re-prompt for policy=required.
frames.acceptanceNotes: After POST /signup 201 the client routes to /signup/phone ONLY when the flag is ON, phoneAtSignup != off, verification.sms is true and phoneVerified is false; otherwise nextAfterPhone(). phonePending resumes at enter-code. EVERY exit/bypass resolves via nextAfterPhone() from re-fetched status: /signup/verify only when verification.email is true AND emailVerified is false; otherwise the app. After any successful sign-in: flag ON + phoneAtSignup=required + phoneVerified=false + sms available → /signup/phone?next=<original>; otherwise ?next=. Exits never block: refresh with ~3s timeout, else use the step-entry snapshot. A sign-in next already pointing at /signup/phone is used as-is and never re-wrapped.

frames.label: (02) Enter phone
frames.summary: PhoneNumberField (country calling code + national number → E.164 preview) at desktop and 375px: idle, client-invalid, valid, and sending (start in flight).
frames.acceptanceNotes: Send code is disabled until libphonenumber-js reports a valid number; the E.164 preview shows the exact string posted to POST /verify/phone/start { phone }. Invalid shows aria-invalid + role=alert on blur/submit, not per keystroke. While sending, inputs + button disable with a spinner so a slow network cannot double-send. Skip is rendered only under policy=optional. Copy promises only contact verification (no sign-in-code / recovery claims — SMS MFA enrolment is separate). The rail's Email step is data-driven (verification.email && !emailVerified) — omitted otherwise. Rail: ordered list, aria-current='step' on the current item, hidden state text per step. Each field instance has unique ids; label/aria-describedby point at that instance.

frames.label: (03) Enter code
frames.summary: 6-cell OtpInput (same primitive as mfa-stepup-mobile, 44x52 cells) with masked number + change-number, paste-aware entry, SMS autofill, expiry countdown, resend cooldown → ready, verifying, and a milestone-only live announcer.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Pasting a 6-digit code into ANY cell fills all six (non-digits stripped) and auto-submits. Cell 1 carries autocomplete=one-time-code. Cells are >= 44x44 (44x52). Confirm is disabled until 6 digits. Resend is disabled with a visual countdown for resendAfterSeconds (Δ start ack), then enabled. Resend calls POST /verify/phone/resend with an EMPTY body (session-bound, targets the server-held pending number — works after a reload). On resend ONLY the cooldown restarts; the expiry countdown takes the server's remaining expiresInSeconds from the new ack (the same unexpired code may be re-sent, lifetime not extended); typed digits are kept. While verifying, cells/Confirm/Resend are disabled — no double submit. Change number returns to enter-phone with the number prefilled. Countdowns are NOT inside a live region; only [data-announcer] (role=status, polite) speaks milestones: code sent, you can request a new code now.

frames.label: (04) Verified → continue
frames.summary: Server-confirmed success (masked number, contact-verification copy only). Continue resolves via nextAfterPhone(): check-inbox when the email is still pending, or straight into the app (Email step dropped from the rail) when email is off or was confirmed in parallel.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Rendered only after POST /verify/phone/confirm 200 with phoneVerified: true — never optimistically. Continue re-fetches GET /verify/status and routes via nextAfterPhone(): data-next='verify-email' → /signup/verify only when verification.email is true AND emailVerified is false; otherwise data-next='app' → ?next= or the default app. Copy claims only that the number is confirmed on the account.

frames.label: (05) Code errors
frames.summary: Wrong code (server-reported attempts remaining), expired code (send a new code), too many attempts / 429 with Retry-After countdown and a Continue-for-now exit, and a confirm-time outage (503 VERIFY_UNAVAILABLE) under both policies.
frames.acceptanceNotes: All fail closed and stay on screen — no navigation, no verified state. 422 CODE_INVALID: the rejected digits are CLEARED, cells keep the error ring, focus moves to cell 1, and Confirm is disabled until 6 new digits are entered (a resubmit cannot burn an attempt); attemptsRemaining comes from the server. 422 CODE_EXPIRED (or client expiry reaching 0:00): cells disabled, copy states no fixed duration, only 'Send a new code' (session-bound /resend). 429 TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Retry-After countdown, continue-without-phone under both policies — never a dead end. 503 VERIFY_UNAVAILABLE / 502 from /confirm: an outage, NOT a wrong code — digits kept, no attempt consumed, Try again re-submits; escape is Skip (optional) or continue-without-phone (required).

frames.label: (06) Send & channel errors
frames.summary: SMS channel unavailable (503 honest degrade, desktop + 375), send failed (502) under optional and required, send rate-limited (429) with and without a pending code, number can't be used (409 after a correct code — no enumeration), server-rejected number (400).
frames.acceptanceNotes: Every state offers a way forward under both policies: optional shows Skip; required shows continue-without-phone in its place. 503 SMS_UNAVAILABLE → Continue. 502 → Try again / different number / escape. 429 RATE_LIMITED → Retry-After countdown; 'I already have a code' ([data-action='enter-code']) is rendered ONLY when phonePending is true — never on a 429 for the first /start; the pending variant's 'Send a new code' uses the session-bound /resend. A first-send 429 under required offers continue-without-phone, never Skip. 409 PHONE_UNAVAILABLE comes only from /confirm after a correct code; copy never asserts another account exists. 400 PHONE_INVALID stays on enter-phone with the SAME invalid semantics as client validation: no success styling, aria-invalid, aria-describedby → the role=alert message. No provider/vendor text is ever rendered.

frames.label: (07) Skip policy
frames.summary: Policy matrix (off / optional / required) and both outcomes: optional with Skip + skipped confirmation; required with no Skip + required-but-SMS-unavailable deferral.
frames.acceptanceNotes: policy=optional: Skip rendered (top bar + link button), no confirm dialog, then nextAfterPhone(); rail shows Phone 'later'. policy=required: NO [data-action='skip'] anywhere in the panel or top bar, info note explains why; EVERY failure state (incl. network / unclassified 5xx) offers continue-without-phone, and the flagged sign-in redirect re-prompts later. policy=off / flag OFF: the route is never rendered.

frames.label: (08) Loading & edge states
frames.summary: Loading skeleton (methods + status in flight, desktop + 375), already verified (auto-advance), resumed after reload (phonePending), SMS-off preflight (step skipped), session expired (401), generic error.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Loading renders a layout-stable skeleton and no Skip until the policy is known. phoneVerified true → auto-advance via nextAfterPhone(). phonePending → resume at enter-code with server cooldown, no new SMS. verification.sms false → route skipped via nextAfterPhone(). 401 (true session failure only) → Sign in with the whole current location as an encoded nested next (/login?next=%2Fsignup%2Fphone%3Fnext%3D…), which the sign-in redirect never re-wraps. Resumed: only phonePending.maskedPhone is known; confirm sends { code } and Resend uses the empty-body /resend. Network/5xx → Try again plus Skip (optional) or continue-without-phone (required) — never retry-only; raw server text never shown.
